environment: Headless Rust app and DoofusDock layout tests plus a loopback Gateway actor test; no live Hermes Gateway or installed UI was used.
notes: Tests prove that identical profile/session IDs on two Gateway connections map to separate pane IDs and persist the owner through close/restore; sidebar reselect queues resume under the registered active owner; GatewayDiscovery attributes SessionResumed to its stable connection ID; stale resume results and peer transcript refresh are fenced by connection owner and request ID. This capability remains partial because a saved-connection picker, concurrent discovery lifecycle, full owner routing for all session operations, live reconnect behavior, installed-Windows interaction, and source-paired acceptance remain open.
